title: Energy Levels Symmetric Top
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the energy levels of the symmetric top using the provided Hamiltonian.

title: Energy Calculation J=0
description: Essential Criteria: The student must compute the energy for J=0 correctly as E'_0 = 0.

title: Energy Calculation J=1
description: Essential Criteria: The student must compute the energy for J=1 correctly as E'_1 = hbar^2/I.

title: Perturbation Approach
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly identify and apply the perturbation method to find the energies for the slightly asymmetric top.

title: Degenerate States Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must analyze the degenerate states for J=1 and derive the correct energy splitting.

title: Hamiltonian Formulation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly formulate the Hamiltonian for the slightly asymmetric top including the perturbation term.

title: Sign and Factor Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or missing factors in the energy equations.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check for consistency in units throughout the calculations.

title: Limiting Cases Consideration
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss limiting cases or assumptions made during the derivation.
